card.name: The word Eastern before place names
card.fires_on: The word Eastern (or -East) right after a preposition, before a region such as Europe, Poland or Java. It also fires on a few odd word-starts, such as the P in Patients or the y in Airy.

modes.label: Eastern before a region
modes.description: The word Eastern after in, to or of, naming a part of the world or a country.

modes.label: Odd word-starts in names
modes.description: A single letter or short piece inside a capitalised word or drug name.
